source_issue.title: Refactor class components to functional components

summary_markdown:
```markdown
## What this issue is about
This issue focuses on refactoring React class components in the Volto project into functional components. This change aims to enhance the development experience by allowing the use of React hooks, which simplify state management and side effects.

## What needs to be done
You will need to convert the identified class components to functional components while maintaining their existing behavior. Special attention should be given to the component lifecycle and user experience (UX). If any parts of the API or the components need to be altered, that must be clearly documented.

## Helpful background
The existing class components limit the use of modern React practices, like hooks. This project had contributions as part of the GSoC 2023 program but is currently stalled, with some components already refactored. Check existing pull requests to ensure efforts aren't duplicated.

## Good first steps
1. Review the current list of components that need refactoring to find one that interests you.
2. Familiarize yourself with React hooks and the Volto codebase.
3. Check out the existing pull requests for guidance and context.
4. Join the discussion in the comments if you have questions or want clarification.
5. Review the contributing guidelines for best practices.
```
